title: Preflight intent scorer + Conftest feedback adapter for VPC IaC pipelines
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Build an automated preflight "intent scorer" that runs in the Terraform CI plan stage to compute a compact risk score for VPC/IaC changes (permission expansion, public ingress, subnet/route alterations). The scorer will synthesize Conftest/OPA policy results into human-friendly findings and attach actionable remediation hints. Deliver a lightweight feedback adapter that converts Conftest output into our CI annotation format, surfaces policy failures in PRs, and produces a dashboard-friendly event payload for post-merge drift detectors.

Goals: 1) Reduce noisy false positives by correlating plan diff heuristics with policy results. 2) Provide deterministic preflight pass/fail plus a graduated risk score (0-100) to enable automated canary upgrades and gated rollouts. 3) Integrate with existing GitHub checks, Redwood Console observability, and the rollout service so canary upgrades can automatically pause on score above threshold.

Non-goals: Full automatic remediation of Terraform state, deep static analysis of remote modules, or replacing security team manual review for high-risk network topology changes.

Success metrics: 1) 40% reduction in manual triage time for VPC plan reviews measured over 6 weeks. 2) <5% false-positive rate on a curated testset of historical changes. 3) 95% of CI runs emit structured Conftest annotations compatible with Console search and incident playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: CI plan stage runs the intent scorer and writes a single JSON artifact with risk_score and top_3_findings.
Conftest adapter normalizes rego failures into the standardized annotation schema and appears in GitHub PR checks with line-level context.
Rollout service can consume risk_score and pause canary when score >= configured threshold.
A dashboard view in Console shows daily distribution of risk_score for VPC repos and exposes the top failing rules.
Unit + integration tests cover heuristics and adapter behavior; test fixtures include at least 10 real VPC plan diffs sampled from production history.
steps: Design: define scorer inputs (plan JSON, provider metadata, module whitelist/blacklist).
Prototype: lightweight scorer in Go (library) that runs alongside terraform plan -> tfjson parser -> heuristic engine.
Policy integration: run Conftest/OPA as usual; implement adapter that converts rego results to annotations and emits structured findings to artifact store.
CI integration: add to existing tf pipeline (plan stage) as an additional step; ensure artifact uploads to S3 and checks to GitHub.
Rollout integration: wire scorer output into rollout service via new webhook/topic; add pause-on-risk policy and test with canary traffic.
Observability: add metrics (risk_score histogram, policy_fail_count), traces for scorer/execution time, and a Console dashboard panel.
notes: Trade-offs: We keep the scorer deterministic and fast (<3s on average) by limiting deep module expansion; this avoids CI slowdowns but may miss nested module risks. Consider a future optional deep-scan job for tagged PRs.
Implementation choices: prefer a Go library to share code with rollout service; Conftest invocation remains external to allow teams to author Rego policies without merging scorer code.
Security: policy outputs may contain resource names/ARNs — ensure artifacts are uploaded to the secure artifact bucket with restricted ACLs and TTL.
Fallbacks: If Conftest fails (runtime error), CI should mark as blocked and surface link to the Conftest logs; emergency override label allows bypass for urgent fixes after manual review.
